## Change

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` for runtime or interface changes
- [ ] Recovery vectors are unchanged, or a separate recovery profile is specified
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated where relevant

Use public test inputs only. Never include real passphrases, email salts, recovery phrases, private keys, or local environment details.
